 THIS PETITION IS COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
 THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:21609  CRL.P No. 4286 of 2023  ORDER
This petition is filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. by accused No.2 to enlarge him on bail.
Charge sheet is filed by the Hullahalli police, Mysore District, in connection with Cr.No.138/2022 registered in their police station.

2. Heard the learned counsel for petitioner and the learned HCGP for respondent-State and perused the material on record.
3.

On a complaint lodged by one Bhagya W/o Manjunath, the aforementioned case was registered against the husband and in-laws of deceased Mamatha for offences punishable under Sections 304B, 498A, 302, 114 r/w 34 of IPC.

As per the complaint averments, complainant's daughter,
deceased Mamatha was given in marriage to accused No.1-Premachnadra on 26.03.2021 and at the time of marriage he was given a dowry of 1.50 lakhs.

After the marriage, the deceased was being subjected to cruelty by her husband and in-laws and they NC: 2023:KHC:21609 were abusing her saying that her character is not good and they were unnecessarily picking up quarrel with her etc.
On 30.08.2022 at about 6.30 p.m., complainant's daughter was found dead in a suspicious circumstances.
Therefore, the complainant alleged that her daughter's husband and in-laws have committed her murder.
4. The police on completion of investigation have filed charge sheet against accused No.1 and the present petitioner.
Names of accused Nos.2 to 5 mentioned in the FIR have been dropped.

Charge sheet is filed for offences punishable under Section 498A , 306 r/w 34 of IPC.
5.

It is the case of prosecution that on 30.08.2022 at about 12.30 p.m. the present petitioner i.e.,
accused No.2 came near the house of the deceased and told her that she is having an illicit relationship with a boy from Jaipur and that he will disclose about the said illicit relationship to her husband and others.
The deceased has committed suicide on the same day at about 5.30 pm by hanging herself.
Hence, it is alleged that, on account NC: 2023:KHC:21609 of the instigation and abetment by the petitioner, the complainant's daughter has committed suicide.

6. The learned High Court Government Pleader has contended that the statement of CW3, a neighbour of the deceased has been recorded wherein, she has stated that on the date of incident the petitioner came near the house of the deceased and abused her making accusation about her character.
He, therefore, contends that the petitioner has abetted the deceased to commit suicide.

sentences.text: Allegations against the petitioner that he has abetted the deceased to commit suicide is a matter which has to be established during trial.
The prosecution has to prove the ingredients of the offence alleged against the petitioner.
Name of the petitioner is not in the FIR.

Even accepting at this stage that the petitioner has gone near the house of the deceased and abused her etc., whether the petitioner has intentionally aided or abetted the deceased to commit suicide is a question which has to be established in due course.
Accused No.1 has been NC: 2023:KHC:21609 enlarged on bail by this Court in Crl.P.No.4086/2023 vide order dated 02.06.2023.
Petitioner is in judicial custody from 19.12.2022.
Investigation is completed and charge sheet is filed.
Hence, by imposing conditions, petitioner can be enlarged on bail.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER i. Petition is allowed.
ii. Petitioner shall be released on bail in Cr.No.138/2022 registered at Hullahalli police station, Mysore District, pending in SC No.57/2023 on the file of V Additional Sessions Judge, Mysuru, subject to following conditions:
1. The petitioner shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
 (Rupees one lakh only) with two  sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court.
2. Petitioner shall furnish proof of his residential address and shall inform NC:
2023:KHC:21609 the Investigating Officer/Court, if there is any change in the address.
3. Petitioner shall not directly or indirectly tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
4. Petitioner shall not indulge himself in committing any offence.
5. Petitioner shall appear before the Trial Court regularly.
